name: Trail 3 (Daman-e-Koh)
description: One of the most popular trails in Margalla Hills, starting near Daman-e-Koh viewpoint with scenic overlooks of Islamabad.

name: Trail 5 (Pir Sohawa)
description: A longer, more challenging trail ending near Pir Sohawa, known for dense forest cover and steep sections.

name: Trail 6
description: A steep and less crowded trail favored by more experienced hikers.

name: Monal Trail
description: Leads toward Monal restaurant, a long and scenic but demanding hike with great views of the city.

name: Trail 1
description: Shortest and most beginner-friendly trail in the range, good for casual hikers and families.
